summary: --vault-id can be used without a label, which is equivalent to --ask-vault-pass or --vault-password-file, using a file, @prompt or a script.
questions: Can I use --vault-id without a label?

answer_card.title: --vault-id without a label
answer_card.answer_md:
Rarely used, but equivalent to `--ask-vault-pass` / `--vault-password-file`:

```bash
ansible-playbook --vault-id dev-password site.yml
ansible-playbook --vault-id @prompt site.yml
ansible-playbook --vault-id my-vault-password-client.py
```
